properties.description: Moving a task from Closed/New to Closed/Acknowledged can fail on the first attempted action with an obscure global stale-revision error. Reproduce a concurrent unrelated update and fix concurrency handling at its owning boundary so unaffected actions succeed while genuinely conflicting edits remain protected. Retain stale-write protection, preserve drafts, and make real conflict feedback understandable. Verify unrelated-record updates, same-record conflicts, rapid actions, and external persisted changes.
properties.title: Bug: Prevent unrelated changes from rejecting Activity board actions
